releaseNotes: 1.0.12: choose visible auto-drive (beta) or fast travel for each trip. Adds native gear changes, road-speed cruising, pedestrian/speeding/red-light options, revised cornering and cruise control, and a dialog that refreshes after stopping. Requires LIB BA Player Location 1.0.0+ and LIB BA Unified UI 1.0.0+.
